program:
[port, ca] = System.argv()
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:ssl)
{:ok, socket} = :ssl.connect({127, 0, 0, 1}, String.to_integer(port),
  [:binary, active: false, verify: :verify_peer,
   cacertfile: String.to_charlist(ca), server_name_indication: ~c"localhost",
   alpn_advertised_protocols: ["h2"],
   customize_hostname_check: [match_fun: :public_key.pkix_verify_hostname_match_fun(:https)]], 3000)
old_shape = match?({:sslsocket, _, processes} when is_list(processes), socket)
IO.puts("TLS_SOCKET_SHAPE arity=#{tuple_size(socket)} tag=#{elem(socket, 0)} legacy_tracking_pattern=#{old_shape}")
IO.puts("TLS_RUNTIME elixir=#{System.version()} erts=#{:erlang.system_info(:version)} ssl=#{Application.spec(:ssl, :vsn)}")
{:ok, info} = :ssl.connection_information(socket, [:protocol, :selected_cipher_suite])
IO.inspect(info, label: "TLS_PUBLIC_CONNECTION_INFO")
{:ok, "h2"} = :ssl.negotiated_protocol(socket)
8 = tuple_size(socket)
false = old_shape
:ok = :ssl.close(socket, 1000)
IO.puts("TLS_SHAPE_PROBE_PASS public_verified_connect=1 close=ok lifecycle_retirement_not_tested")
scope: One verified public OTP SSL loopback connection; public returned socket shape only; no HTTP private calls/process inspection or lifecycle-retirement claim
